_comment: Spec mcp-thin-proxy D7 / NFR-1. Limits are the spec's. 'hosted' applies when CI=1 (GitHub hosted runners are slower and noisier, and their memory accounting differs): the memory limits stay the spec's, only timing and CPU get slack.

win32._comment: Decided by the user 2026-11-18. Measured on Windows (Bun 1.3.12): a worker thread costs at least 26-33 MB working set, ours ~47 MB, and under load the daemon holds three (watcher, job, search), so daemon + 5 proxies + UI peaks at 370-390 MB against 300 on macOS/Linux. Idle workers expire (30 s runner, 60 s search) and a quiet daemon measures 130-200 MB, but under this harness the working set does not fall back after the load (365-408 MB at the end of idle), so no idle limit is asserted; the end-of-idle total is only reported. Following up: task 'One shared worker for jobs, watcher and search'.
